title: Molecular docking and dynamic simulation analysis of BPTF with alkaloids.
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接和MD模拟筛选靶向BPTF蛋白的生物碱抑制剂，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且未涉及TF-DNA结合机制，仅方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: Medulloblastoma, a malignant pediatric brain tumor, involves the bromodomain PHD finger transcription factor (BPTF) protein, an epigenetic regulator linked to tumor progression. Molecular docking and 100 ns molecular dynamics simulations were performed using PyRx and desmond to evaluate five plant based alkaloids Sanguinarine chloride, Coptisine, Chelerythrine, Nitidine and Chelidonine against BPTF. Coptisine showed high docking affinity of -6.8 kcal/mol, followed closely by Sanguinarine chloride and Chelerythrine (-6.6 kcal/mol). Sanguinarine chloride showed low toxicity in protox-III and high stability during simulations with consistent RMSD values (1.0-1.5 A), indicating strong binding. Thus, Sanguinarine chloride emerged as the most promising BPTF inhibitor for potential anti-medulloblastoma therapy.
abstract_zh: 髓母细胞瘤（Medulloblastoma）是一种恶性儿童脑肿瘤，涉及溴结构域PHD指转录因子（BPTF）蛋白，这是一种与肿瘤进展相关的表观遗传调控因子。使用PyRx和desmond进行了分子对接（molecular docking）和100 ns分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟，以评估五种植物源生物碱——血根碱氯化物（Sanguinarine chloride）、黄连素（Coptisine）、白屈菜红碱（Chelerythrine）、光叶花椒碱（Nitidine）和白屈菜碱（Chelidonine）——对BPTF的作用。黄连素显示出高对接亲和力，为-6.8 kcal/mol，紧随其后的是血根碱氯化物和白屈菜红碱（-6.6 kcal/mol）。血根碱氯化物在protox-III中表现出低毒性，并在模拟过程中具有高稳定性，RMSD值一致（1.0-1.5 Å），表明其结合牢固。因此，血根碱氯化物成为最有前景的BPTF抑制剂，用于潜在的抗髓母细胞瘤治疗。
